about: Instruct fails on a Nature Power, a move that calls another (Pokemon Central, Imposizione: Instruct fails when the target's last move calls another; Showdown's gen-9 naturepower has failinstruct). Before, Nature Power was not on the list of moves that call another, and Instruct had the target use it again. A level-10 Pikachu is given Instruct in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Nature Power and is made the faster (set:). The Chansey's Nature Power calls a move; the Pikachu's Instruct then fails. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The wild Chansey used Nature Power!
